meta.note: REQUIREMENTS.md FR-3 describes this set as spanning 'code / summarization / vision / math', but VIBECODING_SPEC.md CARD 03's VALID_TASK_TAGS has no math-related tag and explicitly forbids inventing one on the fly. This fixture therefore covers every category CARD 03's fixed tag list actually supports (code_generation, code_review, debugging, summarization, drafting, approval_notes, planning, ocr, image_understanding, diagram_reading, audio_transcription) and omits a pure-math category until that gap is resolved (see router.py module docstring). audio_transcription was added 2026-09-09 alongside CARD 12 (team addition, not PS-traceable — see REQUIREMENTS.md §6); two lower-value duplicate-coverage prompts were swapped out for it to keep this set at exactly 20, matching FR-3's literal '20-prompt' wording.
